vulnerabilities.reason: Low-severity hash flooding in HashBiMap/LinkedHashMultimap construction, published in guava's repository on 2026-10-31 for 13.0 through 33.7.2. The fix, 33.8.0-jre, was released on 2026-11-02 and is still inside the 7-day release-age wait (until 2026-11-09). Here guava runs only inside the build tools the plugin configures (Checkstyle, Error Prone). Move the floor to 33.8.0-jre once it is aged, then drop this exception.
